name: matsek
description: Tools of the Mathematics Section (Matematička sekcija) at FER: AI tutor, paper reader, problemset search, blog writer — install once, updates flow automatically.

plugins.name: tutor
plugins.description: Autonomous AI tutor: probe → plan → teach, with a live Obsidian-compatible session log. Run /tutor after installing.

plugins.name: problemset
plugins.description: Fine-grained problem retrieval over the community library: ladders by difficulty, build-ups ordered by prerequisites, honest about what the library lacks. Ask for zadaci on a topic.

plugins.name: blog-writer
plugins.description: Guided blog authoring for the library: interview → research → one-concept sections with checkpoints → validated bundle → PR. Say you want to write a blog for the library.

plugins.name: submit
plugins.description: Turn a finished session's experience.md into a personal improvement report, then — with explicit consent on the exact final text — a scrubbed CC BY 4.0 submission to the library. Ships the maintainer's /improve flow too.
